name: Downlands Trust grants
summary: Grants from a volunteer-run charity to local conservation organisations in North East Surrey and the adjoining south London fringe, mostly for tools, livestock, fencing, ponds and chalk grassland management. Applicants email a form; no amount or deadline is stated.

geography.label: North East Surrey and adjoining urban fringe of south London

steps: Application form emailed to the Trust

eligibility.rule: Project work is undertaken in North East Surrey and adjoining urban fringe areas of south London

applicant_types.quote: the Downlands Trust has provided funding that has enabled the Downlands Partnership and other countryside conservation organisations to purchase much-needed tools and equipment

geography.quote: The Downlands Trust awards grants to promote and support conservation work being undertaken in North East Surrey and adjoining urban fringe areas of south London

access.quote: If you would like to apply for a grant, please download and complete the application form below and email it to

effort.quote: This form should be completed electronically and then submitted by email to grants@downlandstrust.org.uk

eligibility.quote: conservation work being undertaken in North East Surrey and adjoining urban fringe areas of south London

after_award.quote: The Applicant will provide updates on progress and photos of the project for which the grant is given.
